mirror_control.definition: Equal outer runes, any center, four axes, radii 1..13, in bounds. No center transform or language test.

limits: Recorded route supplied as input, not rediscovered.
Phase thresholds 7 and 14 were fitted on this route, not held out.
No probability of intended plaintext or arbitrary-sentence construction inferred.
Positive-index key count excludes F=0; not a count of reachable geometric nodes.
Source punctuation and word boundaries are editorial, not recovered rune symbols.
